name: support
description: Amazon Web Services Support The Amazon Web Services Support API Reference is intended for programmers who need detailed information about the Amazon Web Services Support operations and data types.

subcommands.name: add-attachments-to-set
subcommands.description: Adds one or more attachments to an attachment set.

subcommands.name: add-communication-to-case
subcommands.description: Adds additional customer communication to an Amazon Web Services Support case.

subcommands.name: create-case
subcommands.description: Creates a case in the Amazon Web Services Support Center.

subcommands.name: describe-attachment
subcommands.description: Returns the attachment that has the specified ID.

subcommands.name: describe-cases
subcommands.description: Returns a list of cases that you specify by passing one or more case IDs.

subcommands.name: describe-communications
subcommands.description: Returns communications and attachments for one or more support cases.

subcommands.name: describe-create-case-options
subcommands.description: Returns a list of CreateCaseOption types along with the corresponding supported hours and language availability.

subcommands.name: describe-services
subcommands.description: Returns the current list of Amazon Web Services services and a list of service categories for each service.

subcommands.name: describe-severity-levels
subcommands.description: Returns the list of severity levels that you can assign to a support case.

subcommands.name: describe-supported-languages
subcommands.description: Returns a list of supported languages for a specified categoryCode, issueType and serviceCode.

subcommands.name: describe-trusted-advisor-check-refresh-statuses
subcommands.description: Returns the refresh status of the Trusted Advisor checks that have the specified check IDs.

subcommands.name: describe-trusted-advisor-check-result
subcommands.description: Returns the results of the Trusted Advisor check that has the specified check ID.

subcommands.name: describe-trusted-advisor-check-summaries
subcommands.description: Returns the results for the Trusted Advisor check summaries for the check IDs that you specified.

subcommands.name: describe-trusted-advisor-checks
subcommands.description: Returns information about all available Trusted Advisor checks, including the name, ID, category, description, and metadata.

subcommands.name: refresh-trusted-advisor-check
subcommands.description: Refreshes the Trusted Advisor check that you specify using the check ID.
